description: This file contains React hooks for managing database items, including fetching, updating, and tracking lock status of notes, as well as counting related notes for notebooks, tags, and colors within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: isValidIdOrIndex
methods.description: Checks if the provided idOrIndex is a valid string or number.

methods.name: useDBItem
methods.description: React hook for retrieving and updating a specific database item by id or index, with event subscription for updates.

methods.name: useNoteLocked
methods.description: React hook to determine if a note is locked, subscribing to updates.

methods.name: useTotalNotes
methods.description: React hook to count total notes related to a given notebook, tag, or color.
